cameraLock.background: pure black studio sweep above a small centered mound of dark moist soil
cameraLock.lighting: soft upper-left key with a subtle upper-right rim light
cameraLock.centerPoint: the same soil mound, stem axis, and flower head remain on the vertical optical center

stages.label: Seed
stages.biology: One striped sunflower achene rests partly embedded in the same moist soil mound.

stages.label: Germination
stages.biology: The seed coat splits, a white radicle grows downward, and the curved hypocotyl begins lifting toward the surface.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.biology: Two broad green cotyledons open above the soil and the first rough true leaves begin forming.

stages.label: Vegetative Growth
stages.biology: The same annual plant develops a thick hairy stem and expanding heart-shaped leaves.

stages.label: Flower Bud
stages.biology: A single terminal green bud forms, enclosed by overlapping pointed bracts.

stages.label: Bloom Opening
stages.biology: The yellow ray flowers begin unfolding around the still-opening central disk.

stages.label: Full Bloom
stages.biology: The mature head displays a complete ring of yellow ray flowers around hundreds of tiny disk florets.

stages.label: Pollination
stages.biology: A bee briefly visits the open disk while a visible flowering ring progresses inward across the florets.

stages.label: Ray Flowers Fade
stages.biology: The yellow ray flowers wilt and fall while fertilized disk florets begin filling seeds in the head.

stages.label: Seeds Mature
stages.biology: The heavy head bends downward; its back turns yellow-brown and plump striped achenes are visible in the drying disk.

stages.label: Plant Death
stages.biology: The annual plant is fully dead and desiccated: brown drooping seed head, brittle stem, curled dead leaves, and several fallen ray flowers and seeds on the soil.
